name: fb-skill
description: Source-first full-stack development, component verification, approval records and bounded installation for the Topinfo FB ecosystem

interface.shortDescription: 按需取证、经批准实施、如实验证并留痕。
interface.longDescription: Detect the target PC, mobile, screen or Java/SQL project, verify source contracts, record explicit human approval and implementation evidence, and preview installation or legacy FB rule cleanup.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use create-fb-feature to inspect this requirement and the target project. Propose a source-grounded implementation, obtain explicit approval of the current plan, then implement and record fresh verification evidence.
